Furthermore, professional event planners have an __________ (increase) ethical and legal duty to plan and deliver events that are environmentally, socially and culturally responsible.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 명사 duty를 앞에서 꾸미는 형용사 자리이므로 동사 increase를 현재분사(형용사) increasing으로 바꾼다.
det.analysis: have an __________ (increase) ethical and legal duty → 명사 duty를 수식하는 형용사 자리 → increase(동사)를 현재분사 increasing(점점 커지는)으로

questions.passage: The twenty-first-century event manager has a responsibility to their clients and stakeholders that requires the __________ (deliver) of an event which minimises negative impacts and can endure without the overconsumption of resources. Sustainable events will have a positive impact on people, the planet and profit margins.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 'the __________ of'에서 관사 the와 전치사 of 사이의 명사 자리이므로 동사 deliver를 명사 delivery로 바꾼다.
det.analysis: requires the __________ (deliver) of an event → 「the + 명사 + of」 구조의 명사 자리 → deliver(동사)를 명사 delivery(전달, 실행)로

questions.passage: The twenty-first-century event manager has a responsibility to their clients and stakeholders that requires the delivery of an event which minimises negative impacts and can endure without the overconsumption of resources. Sustainable events will have a positive impact on people, the planet and profit margins and thus help to meet the economic, sociocultural and environmental needs of event stakeholders. Furthermore, professional event planners have an increasing ethical and legal duty to plan and deliver events that are environmentally, socially and culturally responsible. Responsible events are sensitive to the economic, sociocultural and environmental needs within a local host community, and are organised in order to create the best output for all involved or affected by the event, and in reality, for many event professionals, sustainability is now __________. This means that placing sustainability at the core of event management practices is not just important, but it has become an essential part of the role, and event organisers must adopt increasingly responsible practices in order to stay competitive.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 많은 행사 전문가에게 지속가능성은 이제 '생존과 동일시된다(equated with survival)'는 맥락이다. 뒤 문장의 '경쟁력 유지'와 이어진다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① equated with survival — 생존과 동일시되는 ←정답 (지속가능성이 곧 생존이라는 핵심)
❌ ② separated from profit — 이윤과 분리된 (본문은 수익에 긍정적이라 반대)
❌ ③ opposed to all ethics — 모든 윤리에 반하는 (본문은 윤리적 책무 강조라 반대)
❌ ④ limited to design — 디자인에 국한된 (본문에 없는 내용)
det.tip: sustainability is equated with survival = 지속가능성이 생존과 같은 것으로 여겨진다

questions.passage: The twenty-first-century event manager has a responsibility to their clients and stakeholders that requires the delivery of an event which minimises negative impacts and can endure without the overconsumption of resources. Sustainable events will have a positive impact on people, the planet and profit margins and thus help to meet the economic, sociocultural and environmental needs of event stakeholders. Furthermore, professional event planners have an increasing ethical and legal duty to plan and deliver events that are environmentally, socially and culturally responsible. Responsible events are sensitive to the economic, sociocultural and environmental needs within a local host community, and are organised in order to create the best output for all involved or affected by the event, and in reality, for many event professionals, sustainability is now equated with survival. This means that placing sustainability at the core of event management practices is not just important, but it has become an essential part of the role, and event organisers must adopt increasingly responsible practices in order to __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 행사 주최자는 '경쟁력을 유지하기(stay competitive)' 위해 점점 더 책임 있는 관행을 도입해야 한다는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① avoid all change — 모든 변화를 피한다 (책임 있는 관행 도입과 반대)
✅ ② stay competitive — 경쟁력을 유지한다 ←정답
❌ ③ cut every service — 모든 서비스를 줄인다 (본문에 없는 내용)
❌ ④ ignore the public — 대중을 무시한다 (사회적 책임 강조와 반대)
det.tip: in order to stay competitive = 경쟁력을 유지하기 위해
